title: Single Nuclei RNA Sequencing of Breast Adipose Tissue (10x Nuclei-Seq)
author: Kevin Nee

Sort nuclei into FACS tubes in 1ml of NWB Centrifuge nuclei at 200xg for 10mins. Resuspend nuclei in appropriate volume of NWB that will achieve a suspension of ~1000 nuclei/ul. Count nuclei using both Countess and hemacytometer with trypan blue. Nuclei counted with trypan blue will be counted as 'dead' by the automated cell counter There may be a discrepancy between the countess and hemacytometer. Recount if error is >5%. Nuclei are ready for loading for 10xSeq. Proceed with manufacturer's instructions. (Thermo Fisher, AMQAX1000, Countess II-Automated Cell Counter)

steps.title: Prepare Tissue and Homogenizer
steps.instruction: Prepare the homogenizer on ice and process the breast adipose tissue.

substeps.instruction: Cut away 40g of adipose tissue from epithelium and stroma.
Mince 10g of tissue at a time into fine (~2mm x ~2mm) pieces to avoid lipolysis.
Place the minced tissue into a 15ml dounce homogenizer (Fisher Scientific, K885300-0015).

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue in 10g portions on ice, inspecting nuclei with a bright-field microscope throughout the process.

substeps.instruction: Add 10ml of NIB to the homogenizer.
Slowly push down the tissue with the A piston.
Run the piston through the tissue 10-15 times until it moves smoothly up and down.
Transfer the fat/nuclei suspension from the homogenizer into a 50ml conical tube through a 70uM mesh filter, changing the filter if it becomes clogged.
Repeat the homogenization and filtration process three times until all 40g of tissue is processed.

steps.title: Isolate and Wash Nuclei
steps.instruction: Centrifuge and wash the nuclei suspension at 4°C.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the nuclei/tissue suspension at 500xg for 5 mins at 4°C.
Carefully remove the supernatant, ensuring the lipid layer is removed first.
Resuspend the nuclei pellet in 1ml of NWB.
Strain the suspension through a 35uM filter into a FACS tube (Corning, 352235).

steps.title: Stain Nuclei for FACS
steps.instruction: Perform a final wash and stain the nuclei with Hoechst.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge nuclei in NWB at 500xg for 5 mins at 4°C.
Resuspend the nuclei pellet in NWB containing 10ug/ml of Hoechst (Hoechst 33342, Trihydrochloride, Trihydrate - 10 mg/mL Solution in Water, Invitrogen - Thermo Fisher Catalog #H3570).

steps.title: Perform FACS Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the Hoechst+ nuclei using a Becton-Dickinson FACS Aria.
